job.question: A county pension fund is searching for a single manager of managers covering domestic equity, international equity and fixed income. What is the maximum mandate size, and what is the firm-level AUM limit for responders?
job.expected_facts: A mandate of up to $350 million; responders must have less than $30 billion in firm-level assets under management (Cook County Fund, RFP 25-0004).
job.acceptance: Accept up to $350m and firm AUM strictly below $30bn. Cook County identification is optional.

reviews.reason: This is a Santa Barbara County Employees’ Retirement System RFP for global custody services, not the manager-of-managers search. It provides neither the maximum mandate size nor a firm-level AUM eligibility limit for responders.
quotes: Request for Proposal Global Custody and Related Services Santa Barbara County Employees’ Retirement System (“SBCERS”)

The primary purpose of this RFP is to identify the most qualified firm to provide global custodial services, accounting services, performance measurement / analytics, and other services to SBCERS as defined in this RFP.
